'''January 2001 Smyrna tournament (13 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Smyrna, Georgia on 13 January 2001. [[Drew Lichtenstein]] won it. It is known from James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1614">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-13-smryna-georgia-01-13-01d1614/ smryna-georgia-01-13-01], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 13 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-13-smryna-georgia-01-13-01d1614/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Lichtenstein]]
